description: Land Acquisition - Diyagama, Kalurata D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with the government's intention to acquire multiple land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
